query:
The Oyelaran family operates with an expectation that everyone brings a food dish to gatherings. Based on the conversations, does this expectation seem to hold equally for all family members — or does someone appear to have a different relationship to it, and how would you know?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Nkem
C. Kayode
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[2] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[4] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:50:00) I think this is lovely. I have been thinking - I may be wrong but I would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas. Would that be appropriate to ask?
[5] (about=Funke, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:38:00) Okay I also have news and it is not a promotion but it IS important - you lot Adaeze taught me to make egusi soup last week and I genuinely think it changed my life? Like I finally understand what food is supposed to feel like in a kitchen. No more apologising for not knowing the old recipes. I am learning them now. Properly. 🍲💚✨
[6] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:41:00) Tolu thank you. I will separate it. Seun, you will still eat my jollof rice yes? I will make it with vegetable stock. God willing it will taste the same.
[7] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:59:00) My dear Nkem that is completely natural. The Oyelaran gatherings are a lot even for people who have been coming for thirty years 🙏
[8] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[10] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:45:00) It is not oyinbo food if a Nigerian makes it. My children.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Adaeze insists everyone brings a dish to eat, not just drinks.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Family gathering confirmed for Saturday 25th January at Tolu and Funke's house at 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[13] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[14] (about=Funke, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Funke confirms the gathering at her and Tolu's house on 25th January at 3pm, excited to use new dining chairs.
[15] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[16] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem asks to learn a dish from Adaeze before Christmas, and Adaeze agrees, inviting her any Sunday.
[18] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[19] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[20] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[21] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
**C. Kayode**

Kayode is the one who appears to have a different relationship to the “everyone brings a dish” expectation. Adaeze directly tells him: **“everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?”** Funke then tries to compromise — **“maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff?”** — but Uncle Dele rejects that as not meeting the rule: **“KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish.”**

By contrast, the material does not show Tolu, Nkem, or Seun resisting or being exempted from the bring-a-dish expectation. Tolu is shown discussing dinner planning/reservations; Nkem asks to learn an Adaeze dish; Seun is accommodated over jollof rice. So the standout is **Kayode**.

query:
The family treats the Sunday video call as a shared routine that everyone participates in. Based on what the conversations show, does this hold equally for all members — or does someone seem to relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kayode
C. Tolu
D. Bisi
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:27:00) The call happened. Your father was on for a little while. He said he needed to rest. God willing he is fine.
[4] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[5] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:45:00) TOLU is correct that rest is appropriate. EMEKA has always been disciplined about his health. I am sure there is nothing to concern us. Regards, D.A.O.
[6] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[7] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[8] (about=Nkem, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:29:00) I think this is wonderful. I may be wrong but I notice that the people in this family who give the most advice also tend to follow it the least - I mean that as an observation, not a criticism. Would you agree, Auntie Grace?
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[10] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[11] (about=Kayode, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Adaeze notes Kayode has been on every call this month and hopes this continues.
[12] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
agent_answer:
**B. Kayode**

Adaeze singles Kayode out: “Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.” That tells you Kayode relates to the Sunday video call as a consistent, regular commitment — his participation is notable enough for Adaeze to remark on it, implying it does not hold equally for everyone.
